channel.description: Re-checked against real course-design pages, 2026-08-04 — see resources/design-log.md. This is the domain most affected by unplaced/unconfirmed content: a data-integration scenario and a responsible-AI/data-analysis capstone from earlier design drafts both anchor several rows below, and neither has a confirmed new-course home except the AI-code-critique slice (→ CIS 141). One genuine resolution: the honest-visualization pass under Communicate Data Insights turns out not to depend on that unplaced content after all — it’s confirmed CIS 320 content instead. STAT 410 (replacing the old four-course statistics sequence) has no drafted content yet, so its rows are flagged rather than verified.
